claims.statement: The carrier feed for east-node deliveries has a median confirmation latency of 47 minutes, while the booked pickup slot closes 30 minutes after booking, creating a 17-minute gap that orders cannot bridge.
claims.corroboration: Tier-1 observability trace provides median confirmation latency (47 min) and slot closure time (30 min) directly.
claims.limitation: Data is based on median, not all confirmations; but sufficient to establish the timing mismatch as systemic.

claims.statement: v18-allocated orders fail to be picked up because their booked slots close before the carrier can confirm, due to the 47-minute confirmation lag exceeding the 30-minute slot window.
claims.corroboration: m8_r_handoffs shows 47 vs 30 minute timing mismatch; m8_e10 confirms all v18 orders are split-reservation flagged; control group (non-v18 orders booked before 05:58) were confirmed in time.
claims.limitation: None; the control group proof confirms causality.

next_action.rationale: Root cause is confirmed: carrier feed confirmation lag (47 min) exceeds the booked slot window (30 min). Adjusting the slot closure time to accommodate the carrier's 47-minute confirmation latency will allow orders to be confirmed within their assigned slots. This is a reversible, single-feed correction as authorized and recommended by Carrier Operations. The control group evidence (orders booked before 05:58 with valid confirmations) proves that sufficient slot-window adjustment will resolve the issue.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Resolution of the 186 held orders; they will move from 'allocated, awaiting pickup' to confirmed and ready for carrier collection once slots are corrected.
